note: Who can create and redeem tokens at the issuer, how, how fast, when and at what cost: the facts that decide whether arbitrage can hold a token's price at the share's. One entry per issuer, keyed by the dossier's `issuer` slug (stocks/data/issuers/<slug>.json, stocks-tokens.json `issuer`). Every sentence rests on the dossier's redemption fields named in `basis`, re-read on `checkedAt`; the dossier carries the quotes and sources, this file carries the reading. stocks/lib/primary-market.mjs derives the verdict and resolves per-token hours; the card's Markets block and the issuer page render it.

ondo-global-markets.whoText: Wallets Ondo has onboarded: KYC, non-US, whitelisted by Ondo. Institutions at the Solana launch; retail “coming soon”. A secondary-market buyer holds a token it cannot redeem until onboarded.
ondo-global-markets.mechanismText: One transaction on Ondo’s program mints or burns the token against USDon or USDC, at a price Ondo’s API signs; Ondo keeps the spread between that price and the share.
ondo-global-markets.settlementText: Instant to USDon; instant to USDC while Ondo’s stablecoin swapper has liquidity.
ondo-global-markets.hoursText: US market hours: Ondo pauses the token outside them (“unavailable in session”).

hoursExceptions.hoursText: 24/7: one of the six tokens Ondo mints and redeems around the clock.

ondo-global-markets.fee: Up to 0.1% of the share price, plus Ondo’s spread and network fees
ondo-global-markets.inKindText: Cash only on Solana. Authorized participants can redeem for the shares themselves through Alpaca, but on Ethereum and BNB Chain, not here.

xstocks-backed.whoText: Authorized participants and professional clients onboarded with Backed, from whitelisted wallets. Not the public: a retail holder sells on an exchange or a DEX.
xstocks-backed.mechanismText: Requests to Backed’s primary market. xPort is the in-kind route: send xStocks from a whitelisted wallet and Alpaca delivers the shares to a linked brokerage account.
xstocks-backed.settlementText: Cash redemption is due by T+5; xPort is advertised as 24/5.
xstocks-backed.hoursText: 24/5 through xPort; the cash route runs on business days.
xstocks-backed.fee: Up to 0.5% of the value per issuance or redemption (the prospectus allows up to 5%); xPort currently free
xstocks-backed.inKindText: Yes, through xPort, for clients onboarded with both Backed and Alpaca; the cash route excludes delivery.

backpack-securities.whoText: Any KYC-verified Backpack Exchange user outside the US, UK, UAE and Japan. On-chain holders have no redemption right of their own: the trustee answers only to Backpack’s own entity.
backpack-securities.mechanismText: Deposit the token into a Backpack account and it becomes a brokerage stock position; withdraw a stock and it becomes the token. On a redemption proper the trustee may sell the shares and pay cash instead.
backpack-securities.settlementText: Deposits and withdrawals settle like any Solana transfer; selling the shares needs US market hours (whole shares only outside them).
backpack-securities.hoursText: Token deposits and withdrawals 24/7; the share leg in US market hours.
backpack-securities.minimum: Per token, from Backpack’s asset list (SPCX: 0.004 to deposit, 0.008 to withdraw); $1 per stock order
backpack-securities.fee: About $0.50 to withdraw a token; no fee to deposit; no trading commission
backpack-securities.inKindText: Yes: the token becomes a brokerage stock position in the same account.

shift.whoText: Professional market makers, through business-to-business endpoints. The series agreements promise members a treasury repurchase by smart contract, but no such program exists on chain.
shift.mechanismText: Market makers mint and burn against the underlying ETF to keep their inventory; users trade against their quotes on Jupiter, Meteora, Kamino and Orca.
shift.hoursText: 24/5, following US trading hours; user trading runs 24/7 with wider weekend spreads (up to 3–5%).
shift.fee: 0.1% on the primary market; the spread in the market makers’ quotes

superstate-opening-bell.whoText: Allowlisted holders with a Superstate account (KYC; sanctioned countries excluded). Only allowlisted wallets can hold the token at all.
superstate-opening-bell.mechanismText: Send tokens to Superstate’s burn address and the shares reappear as book entries in its portal; a DRS transfer then moves them to a broker. Tokenizing runs the other way through the transfer agent.
superstate-opening-bell.settlementText: The burn is instant; the DRS transfer to a broker takes business days; no cash payout.
superstate-opening-bell.fee: No Superstate fee; network, transfer-agent and broker fees
superstate-opening-bell.inKindText: Yes: you get the registered shares themselves.

securitize.whoText: Holders onboarded with Securitize Markets (KYC, US-eligible investors); only whitelisted wallets can hold the token.
securitize.mechanismText: Inbound: DRS the shares to Continental Stock Transfer, then Securitize issues the tokens to a whitelisted wallet. Outbound: asserted in one clause, with no published procedure.
securitize.settlementText: Days inbound (a DRS transfer); nothing published for the way back.
securitize.fee: Not published; brokers’ DRS fees vary
securitize.inKindText: Yes: the token is the registered share in another form.

bullish.whoText: Registered shareholders with an EQ Shareholder Central account, after KYC and wallet approval; street-name holders must DRS their shares to Equiniti first.
bullish.mechanismText: Withdraw tokens from, and return them to, the register through EQ’s portal. Returning tokens gives a book-entry position, not cash.
bullish.settlementText: No turnaround, fee or SLA is published for either direction.
bullish.inKindText: Yes: the token is the share in another form.
bullish.anchorNote: The token trades on Bullish’s own exchange, 24/7, between EQ-approved wallets; with the conversion’s timing unpublished, that price can drift from NYSE’s.

prestocks.whoText: No one on demand: pre-IPO shares cannot be created or redeemed. A non-US holder may ask the operator, which may pay in USDC, offer something else or point to the DEX.
prestocks.mechanismText: No program, address or desk. After an IPO the stated path is conversion into a tokenized public stock, not cash.
prestocks.fee: Whatever the operator sets, without notice; a 1% transfer fee is taken on chain today

tessera.whoText: No one until the issuer sells its stake in the company. Then any holder can burn the tokens for the redemption amount in USDC or USDT, once a redemption start date is announced.
tessera.mechanismText: A burn to Tessera’s contracts, only after a liquidity event; nothing until then.
tessera.settlementText: None until a liquidity event and a redemption start date.
tessera.fee: 0.2% on every sale or transfer, taken on chain; nothing on redemption is published

remora-markets.whoText: No one: Remora wound down in February 2026. The platform that minted and redeemed is offline and the exit pool it pointed holders to is gone.
remora-markets.anchorNote: There is no market left either.

republic-mirror.whoText: No one at the holder’s option: the note pays out after SpaceX’s IPO lock-up ends (staged from Q1 2027), on a formula Republic has not published.
republic-mirror.mechanismText: None: payment comes from the issuer when it comes.
republic-mirror.settlementText: “A reasonable time period” after the lock-up; nothing firmer is published.
